relationships.subject: Moxibustion
relationships.evidence_quote: After treatment, VAS score, morning stiffness score, the number of tender joints, the number of swollen joints, DAS28 score, and the levels of LTB4, IL-17 and MMP-9 in serum were obviously lower in the treatment group when compared with the control group

relationships.subject: LTB4
relationships.evidence_quote: In the treatment group, the changes before and after treatment in the levels of LTB4, IL-17 and TNF-α were positively correlated with that of MMP-9

key_findings: Moxibustion lowered serum LTB4, IL-17 and MMP-9 in RA patients
